data.one_liner: iPhone Duo hinge angle, fold posture and fold/camera regions for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Bridges iPhone Duo hinge angles, fold postures, and display regions to Flutter via a platform channel. Provides widgets and streams to build fold-aware layouts and handle size classes on iOS.
use_when: Building a Flutter app that needs to support the iPhone Duo foldable device
Reading live hinge angles or fold postures on iOS
Adapting layouts based on iOS size classes and fold geometry
avoid_when: Working exclusively on non-iOS platforms where this package provides no fold data
Looking for a generic Android folding screen solution which Flutter handles natively
strengths: Safe to depend on unconditionally on non-foldable and non-iOS devices
Provides both stream-based low-level angle access and InheritedModel widget tree integration
Opt-in MediaQuery display feature bridging to prevent accidental dialog splitting
weaknesses: Limited to iOS foldables (specifically iPhone Duo)
Requires manual Podfile and target adjustments on newer Xcode toolchains
data.setup_notes: Requires raising the iOS deployment target to 15.0 in the Podfile and configuring Xcode build settings for compatibility with newer toolchains.
